scope: Single macOS arm64 1x display, isolated UI and synthetic fixture; other test load existed, not performance evidence.

fullscreen.steps: AX fullscreen button activated; screenshot 1920x1080. Ctrl+Cmd+F sent to app but screenshot/AX did not show exit; app toolbar Restore default window size then restored normal native controls and 1440x900 screenshot.
fullscreen.limitation: Shortcut exit not established; toolbar-mediated exit observed. Transition captures may show transient scaling/margins.

zoom.steps: AX secondary action zoom the window enlarged capture to 1920x991. Toolbar restore returned screenshot 1440x900.

resize.steps: Native window corner drag from [1438,899] to [1100,700] produced 1102x701 screenshot; toolbar restore produced 1440x900 screenshot and notice stating 1440x900 logical pixels.
resize.limitation: Screenshot dimensions are pixel export sizes including possible native edge; no CUA geometry API.

minimize_restore.steps: AX minimize button clicked. App inventory continued reporting process running, target AX and screenshot could still be read; neither reports minimized state. CUA getApp(com.apple.dock) timed out, so no unique Dock window entry could be confirmed or clicked.
minimize_restore.limitation: Neither actual minimize state nor restore is proven. No activate, Raise or workaround used.

capture: Original CUA JPEG/JFIF exports, no conversion.
